messages:
emma: Noticed a consistent pattern on prod canary: reconnect + mid-stream toolcall -> two provisional charges. Example trace attached.

owen: ugh. can you paste the trace/logs and route?

emma: route=/v1/chat/stream model=rw-small-q trace=trc_a9c; logs:
```
[2026-03-18T09:03:02Z] ingress: session=def456 resume_offset=1024 emit_op:op_id=none
[2026-03-18T09:03:02Z] runtime: toolcall=start id=tc_77 in=25 out=8
[2026-03-18T09:03:03Z] billing: provisional_inc tokens=33 reason=resume+toolcall ledger_write_id=L123
[2026-03-18T09:03:03Z] retry: proxy_handoff -> runtime2
[2026-03-18T09:03:03Z] billing: provisional_inc tokens=25 reason=toolcall ledger_write_id=L124
```
Looks like the first ledger write mixes resume suffix + tool output; second write records tool output again.

ravi: are toolcall ids only created downstream? if so handoffs may lose correlation.

emma: exactly. ingress doesn't assign toolcall ids right now. handoff path regenerates a new id and billing treats them as separate ops.

maris: two potential fixes: 1) ingress assigns `op_id` deterministically (session + offset + toolcall hint) and propagate it everywhere; or 2) billing uses fuzzy dedupe window (time+token-count) to merge close writes.

owen: prefer deterministic op_id. Fuzzy rules are brittle and may merge unrelated small calls.

ravi: deterministic op_id must avoid collisions across retries/replays. Use hash(session||offset||toolcall_name||ingress_nonce). ingress_nonce needs to be stable for the same client retry attempt.

emma: we can derive ingress_nonce from the client's request-id header if provided by SDKs; otherwise fallback to monotonic per-session counter.

maris: also console needs to show `op_id` so customers can debug spikes. add column under per-route Billing -> Sessions. keep behind FF.

acct-bot: provisional_charge: route=/v1/chat/stream session=def456 tokens=33 amount=0.012 reason=resume+toolcall

owen: rollout plan proposal:
- runtime: ingress assigns op_id for any incoming stream or toolcall (PR)
- billing: accept op_id and dedupe ledger writes by op_id (PR + migration)
- console: feature-flag column + filter
- monitoring: alert if >1% sessions in a minute have duplicate ledger writes for same op_id
- retro: run a short retro-dedupe job for last 6 hours

emma: can we avoid a schema migration? billing already accepts `meta` blob, we can just use a new key `op_id` there. no DB schema change.

ravi: excellent. downside: we must ensure op_id is included in every handoff/gRPC header - update proxies.

maris: UX ask: make the op_id searchable and copyable, and show provenance badge: ingress vs downstream-generated.

owen: devops note: need accounting approval for retro dedupe. this will move provisional -> refunded entries.

emma: I'll open runtime PR and canary patch. target canary tomorrow morning. assign owners: RNG-2001, BILL-3002, CON-4003.

deploy-bot: canary started: ingress-opid-20260319-canary -> pending

owen: also add integration test: simulate resume+toolcall handoff and assert billing ledger increments == expected unique token count.

acct-bot: retro-dedupe job queued for 60m; will output audit CSV to /billing/audit/opid-dedupe-20260318.csv

maris: after rollout create runbook snippet: "billing spike + reconnects -> check op_id presence, run retro-dedupe" :white_check_mark:

emma: thanks all, will post PRs once ready. cc @ravi for proxy header changes.
